summary: Climber tumbled approximately 600 feet in Bell Cord Couloir, Maroon Bells, and was killed; body recovered by Mountain Rescue Aspen.
location: Maroon Bells traverse, Bell Cord Couloir
notes: Delayed report published 2015. Separate rescuer talus fall with concussion described in same article not counted as separate incident.; Merged 2 reports (parts: aac, news-2010-2019); date per news report; AAC listed 2010-08-15.
